scope: private console probe, local mocks only
checks: Parent A and B: three allowlisted direct GET RPC, then fixed-family Auth GET /user
Unbound third Auth: no profile, household or guessed Missions household
Opened proof flags and incomplete contracts fail without repair or activation
Readiness refusals expose only booleans and a fixed phase; actual family-v2 VM reproduces unloaded/blank controller without HTTP
Raw server errors reduced to a fixed reference and numeric HTTP status
Account/household replacement, persisted-session mismatch and Auth subject mismatch fail closed
Expired or near-expiry sessions and HTTP 401 cause no refresh, retry or POST fallback
Current client capabilities are read after the final Auth await; fixed-domain redirects are refused
Exact Console entry emits one aggregate JSON and no session object
limits: No live service, password login, e-mail, invitation, Storage object or concurrent session tested locally.
The future user-run probe verifies an Auth HTTP session and PostgREST read endpoints, not the password-grant request itself.
The probe never calls the native authorized transport, refresh, retry, or metadata writers; it refuses sessions with less than 120 seconds remaining.
